 Stand or sit at your desk?


 Tim Cross

Senior science writer


 Several years ago The Economist’s offices were refitted with
 
https://click.e.economist.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzB9AAcAAAAABVY6Yd2mrBmt0yKBsBxOHsOT7OIvOAXEIq9hJoKhOSRomR3i6Kh7NrL5DTO1gRoma7imj65wFGhIjLzIUSTUkwjdIsYA0n4pOceLkg 
standing desks .
 An electric motor and a pair of buttons meant you could easily adjust the desk’s height. The lazy and slothful could sit down as usual. The dedicated and virtuous could raise the desk’s height and work standing up.
